title: Empty output after decoding
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Gamma$ be a symbol alphabet, let $x$ be a finite input word over $\Gamma$, and let $D$ be a configuration on $x$ with $k$ work tapes. Given an embedding of the Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$, the output of the configuration obtained by decoding $D$ is empty.
